## ✨ Highlights

- **Windows desktop app** — HarnessKit's desktop app now runs on Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit), with the same features as the macOS build. Download the installer (`HarnessKit_1.15.0_x64-setup.exe`) from the [GitHub release page](https://github.com/RealZST/HarnessKit/releases/latest). It is not code-signed yet, so Windows shows a SmartScreen warning on first run (More info → Run anyway). The app updates itself from this version on.
